people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Samuel listened to all the words of the people and repeated them in the hearing of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
translations.asv: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Jehovah.
